name: 3Up 3Down
summary: Shedding card game where players must beat the discard pile, with 3 face-up and 3 blind cards saved for the endgame.
rules_text: Each player gets 3 face-down blind cards (3DOWN) they cannot look at, then 6 cards to look at; they choose 3 to place face-up on their blind cards as their 3UP pile. Remaining 3 cards form their starting hand. Remaining deck is draw pile. On your turn clockwise you must play a card >= top of discard pile; you may play multiple copies of same rank together. If you can play, you must; after playing you refill hand to 3 from draw pile if possible. If you cannot play, you take the entire discard pile into your hand. Clear, Clear+1, Clear+2 beat any number and remove the discard pile from game; Clear ends turn, Clear+1 requires one extra play (may draw first), Clear+2 requires two extra plays. Three consecutive same numbers by any players also clears. When draw pile empty and hand empty, play from 3UP, then blindly flip one 3DOWN per turn if legal. First to empty all piles wins.
rating_reason: Card shedding with hidden down cards, turn-based strategy.
